title: Seven months of searching for a small business — and the calculator it produced
tldr: 78 listings inquired, 28 NDAs, three deals deep, zero closed — and the screening filter, three-approach valuation method, and open-source SBA deal calculator the search produced.
metaDescription: How seven months of small-business acquisition searching (78 inquiries, 28 NDAs, three deals taken deep) produced a screening filter, a three-approach valuation methodology, and a free open-source SBA deal calculator.

title: Oil, god, and open weights

metaDescription: Reflections on the open-weights debate (the Nvidia coalition letter, Anthropic's position, and 'AI is Oil, Not God'), plus what I shipped and what I'm thinking about, week of July 21–28, 2026.
